title: Dual-Mode Tracking Paradigm for Livestock Monitoring
technical_innovation: Formulation of two complementary tracking modes: causal online tracking (RealTime-Fast) for low-latency alerts and retrospective offline tracking (Hybrid-ByteTrack) with backward trajectory smoothing for longitudinal profiling.
empirical_evidence: On 12 development videos, Hybrid-ByteTrack eliminates ID switches (0 IDSW, IDF1 0.9911, HOTA 0.8982), while RealTime-Fast achieves 25 IDSW (IDF1 0.9700, HOTA 0.8860), outperforming Raw ByteTrack (64 IDSW, IDF1 0.8879, HOTA 0.8111).
paper_role: Section 4: Tracking Methodology and Empirical Performance

title: Multimodal Spatiotemporal Sequence Modeling for Pig Behavior Recognition
technical_innovation: Integration of visual crop features, 2D/3D trajectory dynamics, and social partner representations within a sequence modeling framework evaluated under strict video-group balanced cross-validation.
empirical_evidence: Model A establishes a high-ceiling baseline (Macro-F1 0.6778); Model B provides complementary latent features (0.6698); fixed 50/50 ensemble E_J achieves the highest validated system performance (Macro-F1 0.6939).

title: Class-Aware Gated Spatial Representation & Synergistic Ablation Decomposition
technical_innovation: Conditioning local spatial attention on behavioral class priors via learned gating, verified through a formal 2x2 factorial matrix and neutral scaffold control.
empirical_evidence: 15 physical checkpoints demonstrate that un-gated spatial attention alone is neutral (+0.0000 vs scaffold), class gating is the primary driver (+0.0051), and their combination yields Case D synergistic interaction (+0.0017 descriptive synergy, total +0.0069 vs scaffold).
paper_role: Section 6: Architectural Ablation and Factorial Decomposition

title: Downstream Behavior Profile Distortion Under Fixed Behavioral Ground Truth
technical_innovation: Methodological isolation of tracking identity error propagation into individual pig behavior time budgets by evaluating trackers under fixed, human-reviewed behavior annotations.
empirical_evidence: Raw ByteTrack induces 0.0953 mean A1 Total Variation distortion; RealTime-Fast reduces distortion to 0.0309; Hybrid-ByteTrack reduces distortion to 0.0001 (LOOV 12/12 positive across all pairwise comparisons).

title: Duration-Weighted Wrong-Identity Exposure Metric for Longitudinal Precision
technical_innovation: Formulating cumulative wrong-ID exposure frames as a continuous physical measure of identity contamination, resolving the limitation of discrete ID switch counts.
empirical_evidence: Wrong-ID exposure frames show a significantly higher Spearman correlation with profile distortion than discrete ID switches for Raw ByteTrack (Delta abs rho = +0.0668, 95% CI [0.0116, 0.1501]).
paper_role: Section 7: Tracking Error vs. Profile Distortion Analysis
